answer: Hold back most of each reward: pay 20 percent now and lock 80 percent for 12 epochs while three random peers re-check the answer. At 50 tokens per epoch, 100 clones keep 48,000 tokens locked on a knoll of pending rewards, while honest agents collect at dawn.
